SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      substr(NULLIF(local_day, ''), 1, length(local_day) - 3) AS period,
      SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
      SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      SUM(turn_count) AS turn_count,
      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns), 0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns), 0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns), 0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known), 0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(c_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(c_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_approximate) AS approximate_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_duration_missing) AS missing_duration_turns,
      SUM(unknown_time_turns) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(stale_turns) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(last_successful_update) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (
      SELECT
      provider,
      project_key,
      session_id,
      local_day,
      input_tokens,
      output_tokens,
      total_tokens,
      turn_count,
      completed_turns,
      recorded_turns,
      recorded_completed_turns,
      cache_write_input_tokens,
      cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      cache_read_input_tokens,
      cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      c_input_tokens,
      c_output_tokens,
      c_total_tokens,
      c_cache_write_input_tokens,
      c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      c_cache_read_input_tokens,
      c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      c_duration_ms,
      c_duration_ms_known,
      c_exact,
      c_derived,
      c_approximate,
      c_duration_missing,
      r_input_tokens,
      r_output_tokens,
      r_total_tokens,
      r_cache_write_input_tokens,
      r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      r_cache_read_input_tokens,
      r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      r_duration_ms,
      r_duration_ms_known,
      r_exact,
      r_derived,
      r_approximate,
      r_duration_missing,
      unknown_time_turns,
      stale_turns,
      last_successful_update,
      min_started_at_ms
    FROM usage_request_daily AS turn_summary
    WHERE 1 = 1
      AND ((local_day <> '' AND local_day >= ? AND local_day < ?))
    ) AS turn_summary
    GROUP BY provider, period
    ORDER BY period IS NULL, provider, period
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?
